name: persona-model-comparison-natural-25turn-v1
description: 25 identical synthetic user messages across three real-host sessions, including two transport restarts. Deliberately tests thinking aloud versus commitment, brevity, corrections, conversational grounding, procedural interruption and multi-session continuity. All quality judgments require independent human scoring.
